### Point d’attention

Une règle spécifique s'applique si le PEA héberge des titres non cotés. Les dividendes versés par ces titres ne sont exonérés d'IR que dans la limite de 10 % du montant de leur valeur d'acquisition. La fraction excédant ces 10 % est imposable l'année de son versement.   
  
Exemple : Pour une acquisition de 3 000 € de titres non cotés, la part des dividendes annuels dépassant 300 € sera fiscalisée.

relevant_laws.name: PEA tax regime
relevant_laws.description: After 5 years of holding a PEA, capital gains are exempt from income tax, only subject to social levies (17.2%).
Capital gains and income from a CTO are subject to a Flat Tax (PFU) of 31.4% or can be taxed under the individual income tax (IR) scale.

relevant_laws.description: The maximum contribution limit for a PEA is €150,000.

relevant_laws.description: Dividends from unlisted securities held in a PEA are tax-exempt up to 10% of their acquisition value, with excess amounts being taxable.

key_facts: épargne en Actions) offers tax advantages for long-term capital gains after 5 years, with only social contributions (17.2%) applied, compared to the CTO (Compte-Titres Ordinaire) which has a 30% Flat Tax (PFU) or income tax.
ETFs replicating synthetic indices like S&P 500 or MSCI World can be held within a PEA, allowing access to global markets while benefiting from the PEA's tax regime.
The PEA has a lifetime investment limit of €150,000.
Dividends from unlisted securities held in a PEA are only tax-exempt up to 10% of their acquisition value; amounts exceeding this are taxable in the year of payment.
The PEE (Plan d'épargne entreprise) and PER (Plan d'épargne retraite) are employee savings schemes with different tax implications and purposes compared to PEA and CTO.
For CTO, capital gains and income are taxed at a PFU of 31.4% or via the income tax scale.
Amundi MSCI World UCITS ETF (CW8) and iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF (CSP1) are mentioned as top ETFs for long-term investment.
Lyxor PEA Nasdaq-100 UCITS ETF and BNP Paribas Easy S&P 500 UCITS ETF are also highlighted for their performance and eligibility for PEA.
ETFs tracking indices like MSCI World, S&P 500, and Nasdaq are popular choices for PEA investments.
The PEE allows employees to save through company-sponsored schemes, including profit-sharing and employee profit-sharing.
